heard: Thousands stared at the burning ship, unaware it carried tons of explosives. At 904 a.m. the ship blew apart. Sparks from a collision had ignited deck benzol. It became the largest human-made explosion before the atomic age. The Richmond district was completely obliterated. Flying glass-blinded hundreds watching from their windows. Two thousand people died in the catastrophe. Thousands stared at the burning ship before the harbor vanished.
